mentions.name: GamingGaiden
mentions.description: An open-source gameplay time tracker for Windows that tracks play time for PC and emulated games. Created as a maintained, open-source replacement for the original closed-source, abandoned Gameplay Time Tracker, and improved and maintained for 3+ years with a moderate audience in its niche.
mentions.problem: The original Gameplay Time Tracker was closed source and abandoned, leaving no maintained open-source option for tracking gameplay time.
mentions.audience: Windows PC and emulated-game players who want to track their gaming time
mentions.source_excerpt: A gameplay time tracker for PC and emulated games on windows I wrote to track my personal gaming hobby.
mentions.author: kulvind3r
